title: What the Tibetan Blue Bear hides

is_this_you.pressure: Pushed, you climb past where anyone wants to follow, and wait above the scree until the shouting stops.
is_this_you.love: Few people get your real face. The ones who do had to walk up the mountain and check the story for themselves.
is_this_you.cost: The tale about you grows each winter you stay away, and by now some people like the tale better.

opener.text: The word yeti may be a bear's name in disguise. Swami Pranavananda traced its "teh" to the Tibetan dred, bear [s7]. When Hillary's 1960 expedition carried home scraps of "yeti fur", two of them proved to be the pelt of this bear [s6] [s7]. A Capricorn born in a Dog year knows that story from the inside. People will build a monster out of you sooner than walk up and look.

howto: Three camps on the way up. Climb at your own pace.

tabs.label: The legend
tabs.intro: Earth on Earth, and a story bigger than the bear.

rows.text: Capricorn is cardinal Earth under Saturn, the sign that sets a far goal and keeps walking [s1] [s2]. The Dog is yang Earth, loyal and careful, with a few people it would do anything for [s3] [s4] [s5]. In you the two make one steady weight on the mountain, hard to find and harder to move.

In 2017 a team led by Charlotte Lindqvist tested yeti relics, and a femur from a Tibetan Plateau cave turned out to be Tibetan brown bear [s8] [s9]. People have preferred the legend of you to the plain animal. The plain animal is warmer, and it is real.

tabs.label: The high cold
tabs.intro: Thin grass, long walks between meals, a den in the scree.

rows.text: This bear keeps to alpine meadow and steppe above 4,000 metres [s11]. India's first documented record of so rare a bear came only in 2024 [s6] [s11]. You live where few care to visit. That keeps out the curious, and a few you might have liked.

Brown bears never sink into the deep torpor of a dormouse; the heartbeat slows, and a disturbance wakes them easily [s13] [s14]. You go still for a season the same way, and hear every footstep near the den.

The Dog holds back and struggles to voice its thoughts, and Capricorn's shell can read as cold [s4] [s5] [s2]. Together they let silence answer for you. One plain sentence from you would end a season of guessing.
You do well far from crowds and on hard ground. Ranger posts, survey crews and audit work all pay for patience with thin evidence.

tabs.label: Who sees the real you
tabs.intro: Three who made the climb. One who storms the slope.
tabs.love_lead: In love you keep people at a distance until they show they came for you and not for the story. After that you guard them hard, the way the Dog guards its few [s5]. Three animals line up well with you.

easy.why: The Koala (Taurus, Rabbit year) is your secret friend, since the Rabbit is the Dog's hidden ally, and Taurus is Earth like you [s3] [s1].
The Mountain Pygmy Possum (Capricorn, Rabbit year) shares your sign and the Rabbit and Dog pact, high in its own mountains [s3].
The Moose (Taurus, Horse year) carries the Horse of your trine of Tiger, Horse and Dog, with Taurus for a second Earth [s3] [s1].

hard.why: The hard one is the Humpback Whale (Cancer, Dragon year): the Dragon clashes with the Dog, and Cancer sits opposite Capricorn [s3] [s1].

story.text: In Chinese this bear is 藏馬熊 (zàng mǎxióng), the Tibetan horse bear [s6] [s12]. The Horse stands in the Dog's own trine [s3]. Our reading: a Dog-year bear has carried a trine friend in its name all along, and whoever reaches you will likely arrive at a run.

closing: Come down the slope one morning and let them look. The real bear was always better than the yeti.
